scenes.headline: How vLLM tunes prefill and decode for a hybrid model
scenes.sub: vLLM's recipe for Qwen3.8-2.4T on GB300, one step at a time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tango! Here's how vLLM tunes serving for a two point four trillion parameter hybrid model.

scenes.text: On a hybrid model, the linear layers' fixed state sets the page size for the attention layers: 2,112 tokens a block, not 16.
scenes.say: The key: on a hybrid model, the linear layers' fixed state sets the attention layers' page size.

scenes.title: Prefill and decode, on separate engines

steps.say: An eight-thousand-token prompt arrives. Prefill engines read it all at once and build its cache.

steps.note: prefill and decode size their blocks independently
steps.say: The cache moves to separate decode engines. The hand-off needs the same block size on both sides.
Decode writes the answer, one token per step.

scenes.title: Why a block is 2,112 tokens
scenes.say: Sixty-nine gated DeltaNet layers, twenty-three full-attention layers, and one block size that must hold either.

parts.note: one DeltaNet state: 4 MiB plus 120 KiB, fixed per request
parts.say: DeltaNet keeps one fixed state per request, however long the prompt.

parts.note: full attention: 2 KiB per token per layer
parts.say: Full attention grows token by token.

parts.note: 2,108 tokens, aligned to 16: 132 times vLLM's usual block
parts.say: One state equals two thousand one hundred and eight tokens; rounded to sixteen, a block is two thousand one hundred and twelve.

scenes.title: Requests one decode engine's cache can hold
scenes.note: the same 1,333 GiB of weights; sharding wider frees cache
scenes.say: Walk the memory ladder the server prints at startup. Sharded one way, an engine caches a hundred and twelve requests; sharded wider, a hundred and eighty.

items.say: Check the CUDA graph estimate, because it's charged to your cache.
Benchmark prefill and decode apart, then combine only the winners.
Find where speculation stops paying. Two doublings past two fifty-six, it costs sixty-two percent of throughput.

steps.say: The post's own decode sweep: eight setups, speculation on and off.
Solid red is speculation on eight GPUs. It peaks at two fifty-six, then falls.
Only solid blue, the setup holding the most cache, keeps climbing with it on.

scenes.text: On a hybrid model, price the linear layers first: they set the block size and a fixed share of every request.

recap: Memory ladder: weights, overheads, then cache
Tune prefill and decode apart, then combine
scenes.say: To recap: price the cache, let the linear layers set the block, tune each phase alone.
